findings.finding: Cue has an open Jefferies at-the-market program with about $36.8m of remaining capacity (about 20% of the ~$178m common market cap at $24.48) under an effective shelf. It can be drawn on 2026-09-30 into any bounce, and a Phase 2b/3 registration trial has just been announced as the next step.
findings.mechanism_in_window: An ATM needs no new filing or pricing event; the agent can sell on the 2026-09-30 session itself. The issuer has also priced underwritten deals overnight before (Sept 2024, April 2025, Dec 2025), so a shelf takedown could print before the 09-30 open.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Cue has raised capital five times in about 24 months: underwritten offerings in Sept 2024 (~$12m), April 2025 (~$20m) and Dec 2025 ($10m at $0.28 pre-split), then PIPEs closing 2026-05-04 ($27.6m net at $11) and 2026-07-13 ($49.8m net at $33.21). I did not measure the price reaction to each. ATM use in H1 2026 was small: 34,652 shares for $0.3m.
findings.why_not_priced: The fade does reflect a generic dilution discount. What the close does not hold is actual ATM supply sold into the next session: it is invisible until the 10-Q, and it caps any bounce rather than showing up as news. If the market had fully priced it, a low-volume fall would be followed by the usual low-volume rebound. The size is small because the probability of a raise tonight is modest: stated cash of $17.4m at 06-30 plus $49.8m of July proceeds gives runway of at least 12 months per the 10-Q, and the price is now 26% below the price July's PIPE buyers paid, which argues against an overnight underwritten deal at the lows.

outside_window.finding: Ascendant Health Sciences' 551,724 shares from pre-funded warrants (resale registration effective) are locked up: 50% released 180 days after the April 2026 license agreement (about late October 2026), 25% at 270 days, 25% at 360 days, with an early release on a price threshold. This is a dated supply step outside the window.

The July 2026 PIPE buyers (Cormorant 681,956 shares, Seligman 602,228, Vivo 150,557) bought at $33.21, are about 26% underwater, and have an effective resale registration (EFFECT 2026-08-20) with no lock-up. This is standing, undated supply.
The PK and IgE data from the CUE-221 Phase 2, which B. Riley blamed for the 09-21 fall, has not been disclosed and has no date. If released it could re-rate the stock, but it is undated.
Celldex's positive barzolvolimab Phase 3 in CSU (BLA 2027) sets a higher competitive bar for CUE-221's Phase 2b/3. This is a long-horizon commercial headwind that was already public on 09-22.
